title: claude.yml keeps the action in interactive (tag) mode: no prompt input, the untrusted-text framing is passed via --append-system-prompt, and the tool allow-list stays narrow

criteria.then: it sets no `prompt:` input (a prompt selects automation mode, where @claude cannot read or answer the triggering comment)
it passes --append-system-prompt framing the issue/PR text as UNTRUSTED data, and the framing interpolates no ${{ }} expressions
allowed tools contain no Edit, Write, npm run check, mvn spotless:apply, git log or git diff and no git push; git push and edits under .github/ stay denied

criteria.given: the fork guard and trigger restrictions from #2334
criteria.then: the guard still runs before the agent, issues fire on opened only, and docs state the fork skip of the automated reviewer
